President John Dramani Mahama has paid a visit to former President Nana Akufo-Addo at his residence in Nima, Accra.
The two leaders discussed matters of national and international concern during the meeting on Tuesday morning, November 17, 2026.
President Mahama was accompanied by Chief of Staff Julius Debrah and Deputy Chief of Staff in charge of Operations, Stan Xoese Dogbe.
The visit brought together the sitting President and his immediate predecessor for discussions on issues concerning Ghana and the international community.
